definitions: To make someone feel sad or depressed.
To start to seriously deal with or give attention to something.
To move from a higher position to a lower one.
To write something down; to record something.
examples: The constant rain really gets him down.
It's time to get down to business.
The cat gets down from the table.
She gets down all the important points in her notebook.
He really gets down on the dance floor.
